document.title: Reviews group the same way across runs: group ARI 0.72 → 0.81, half the expect failures
document.summary: The CLI packs the files to read into `show --batch` batches, and the skill is rewritten around them with grouping tie-breaks. The eval also gains Claude Code and Cursor producers.
document.why: [PR #194](source:s1) says reviews of one change grouped differently from run to run, and the skill took long to read and was hard to follow.

sources.label: PR #194
sources.title: Reviews group the same way across runs: group ARI 0.72 → 0.81, half the expect failures
sources.gist: CLI read batches, skill tie-breaks, Claude and Cursor eval producers.

lookFor: [PR #194](source:s1) says `show --batch` packs files into about 23 KB batches. At head `BATCH_CHARS` is 25,000 characters, and `packBatches` prints a hunk bigger than that whole and alone: batch 2 of this PR is 40,547 characters, past the 30,000-character Bash cut that the `BATCH_CHARS` comment names.

groups.title: Read batches and size guess
groups.summary: `readingPlan` in `batch.ts` picks the files to read and packs them into batches that `show --batch` prints. `digest` adds a `read:` line and a size guess, and `pregroup` writes that guess as `size`.

attention.note: `skipReason` leaves out lockfiles, images, binaries, +0/-0 renames and copies, moves, generated files, and every mirror but the first. The skill reads a skipped file only when the agent asks with `show --file`. A mirror matches on identical added and removed lines, so a copy with the same lines at another place is not read. Decide whether this skip list is safe for any reviewed repo.

questions: Why are the `guessSize` floors 20, 200, 550, and 2,000 changed lines?

notes.body: `suggestedOrder` now starts at 0 when the draft has no change group.

fileNotes.src/review/batch.test.ts: Checks skip order, hunk splits, and the per-reason skip count.
fileNotes.src/review/size.ts: New: maps changed lines to a `size` band and a reason.

fileNotes.src/cli/commands.ts: `pregroup` writes the guessed `size`, where the skeleton wrote `small`.
fileNotes.src/cli/commands.test.ts: Checks the `read:` and size lines, batch 1, and the past-end error.
fileNotes.src/cli/args.ts: Parses `--batch`; a non-integer or a value under 1 is an error.
fileNotes.src/cli/args.test.ts: Expects `batch: undefined` in each parsed request.

groups.title: Mirror pairing after a binary
groups.why: [PR #194](source:s1) says the shift could mark a unique file as a mirror, so `show --batch` would skip it.
groups.summary: `buildDigest` now pairs each digest with its own file before `markMirrors`, so a skipped binary no longer shifts the pairing. `show --batch`, `pregroup`, `refresh`, and the coverage checks all call `buildDigest`.

notes.body: This filter drops non-image binaries, so the old `files[i]` index pointed at the wrong file.

fileNotes.src/review/digest.ts: `markMirrors` takes `{ file, digest }` pairs; the `files[i]` lookup is gone.
fileNotes.src/review/digest.test.ts: Binary first; before the fix, `z/other.md` was marked a mirror.

groups.title: Skill rewrite with tie-breaks
groups.summary: The skill puts each rule in one section, reads by `show --batch` in step 3, and adds tie-breaks for groups and parts. The `.agents/skills/comprehende/` files repeat `skills-next/comprehende/`, and the digest marks them the same change, so read the `skills-next` files and skip the copies.

attention.note: Step 4 now says a close split or merge call keeps one group, and Grouping drops the old hint that a review of more than five files rarely fits one group. Runs agree more often, but a review can hold fewer, bigger groups. Decide whether bigger groups are an acceptable price for the higher group ARI.

focus.caption: The new grouping tie-breaks for helpers, fixtures, and mirrors.
Story rules: feature layers are one part.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: Seven steps; Ground rules, Grouping, Parts, and Fields sections.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/power: The write block moves from step 4 to step 5.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/refre: Step 3 reads by `show --hunk`; step 5 runs validate itself.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/skill.test.ts: Drops exact-sentence asserts; keeps the step-2 batch and write-block checks.

groups.title: Claude Code and Cursor producers
groups.summary: `parseProducer` sends a `claude-*` model to `runClaudeCodeAgent` and a `cursor/<model>` model to `runCursorAgent`, both on the shared `runHeadless`; other models stay on Muse. Case lines and run totals print producer cost and reasoning tokens when the runner reports them.

attention.note: `runClaudeCodeAgent` passes `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and `runCursorAgent` passes `--force --trust --sandbox disabled`. The producer runs any shell command on the developer's machine with their CLI login, and no flag in these arguments limits it to the clone. Decide whether an eval run may run unchecked like this.

notes.body: Claude and Cursor get these folders as `--add-dir`; `runProducer` does not pass them to Muse.

fileNotes.scripts/eval/producer.ts: New `Producer` union and `parseProducer`; `runProducer` picks the runner.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/claudecode.test.ts: Two blocks of message `m1` count as one step.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/cursor.test.ts: Steps are model calls plus the answer; a cut run keeps the init id.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/headless.ts: New: spawns with a timeout and ignores stdin EPIPE.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/headless.test.ts: `true` exits before reading 10 MB of stdin; the run returns 0.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/args.ts: Adds `--producer-effort`; a `parseProducer` throw becomes an argv error.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/args.test.ts: Rejects effort `huge`, effort without `claude-*`, and a bare `cursor/`.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/musecode.ts: Muse now reports `reasoningTokens`, so its case lines print `reasoning`.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/result.ts: Case lines add `producer $` and `reasoning`; totals add producer cost.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/report.ts: The report header prints the producer effort after the model.
fileNotes.docs/eval.md: Documents both producers, their logins, and how to resume them.

commits.subject: Eval: keep an early-exiting producer CLI from crashing the run with EPIPE
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Digest: pair each digest with its own file when marking mirrors
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A skipped binary shifted markMirrors' index-based pairing, so a later file could be marked a mirror from another file's lines, and show --batch then skipped it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Skill: tie-break grouping and parts choices for consistent reviews
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Runs of the same change flipped on the same few calls. Each rule settles one:
- File notes give the old and new result; a changed message, error, or scope counts inside a refactor or move. Moves name their callers. The fact list comes before the write call; the drop rule covers only your own refactor ideas.
- A close split or merge call keeps one group. Draft mirrors groups of one kind of edit merge.
- Only a contract gets a foundation group; a helper stays with its first user. An option sits with the code that reads it.
- Fixtures of one change stay in one group, trailing only when their digest lines outnumber the code's; a case's own branch stays with the code.
- One pattern across many files is one group.
- Layers a feature needs are one story; work that builds on it (authoring tools, templates, a demo) is its own story. Feature docs stay in their story.

Ungraded Claude benches (Opus high, Sonnet high, Haiku medium; 5 cases; pooled n=6): group ARI 0.719 -> 0.805, parts ARI on cases with parts 0.69 -> 0.80, deterministic expect failures 15 -> 8-9 per bench. must and good are not graded for these rules.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Eval: check the skill's batch and write blocks, not reworded sentences
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Eval: add a Cursor CLI producer
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
--producer-model cursor/<model> runs the producer through cursor-agent -p
with the CLI's own login (CURSOR_API_KEY and CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN are
removed). The model string goes to --model verbatim; --producer-effort is
an error for it. Muse stays the default. The Claude and Cursor runners
share one spawn helper.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A usage limit ends as subtype success with is_error true; the case line

commits.subject: Skill: restore the full fact list; drop the five-file group hint
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
v2 measurement (45 Claude runs): the terse fact list saved almost no
output but lost cause and mechanism facts (must 172 -> 154 of 225).
The five-file hint, now prominent, split vitadeck-144 into 18-25
groups and cigster into 12-23.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: CLI: drop directory drafts from pregroup
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Measured on 45 Claude runs: models kept the folder guesses, so
vitadeck-144 went from 11-16 groups to 15-34 and grouping agreement
between runs fell for Opus (ARI 0.89 -> 0.70). show --batch and the
size guess stay.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Skill: rewrite for one place per rule; read by batch; terse fact list
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Each rule now lives once: steps carry the actions and a short Done, the
Grouping and Fields sections carry the rules. A story has one
definition (Parts). Step 3 reads the change with show --batch. Step 5
lists facts one terse line each before the write. dir-<name> drafts
are regrouped by concern; the draft size is a line-count guess the
agent judges. About 0.73x the words.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
show --batch <n> prints the files a reviewer reads, packed into batches
that fit one agent tool result; batch 1 lists the skipped files. The
digest names the batch count and a size guess from reviewable lines.
pregroup splits the change group by directory past 8 files (never
inside a package) and writes the size guess into the draft.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Eval: run the producer in Claude Code for a claude-* model
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
--producer-model claude-<x> runs the producer through claude -p with the
CLI's own login (API key variables are removed). --producer-effort sets
its effort. Muse stays the default. Case lines show producer cost and
reasoning tokens when the agent reports them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
